results.content: Four Warning Signs for Ken Paxton in New Poll The new poll from the University of Texas and Texas Politics Project underscored the race's competitive nature. Ken Paxton Support Drops Paxton’s support has slipped since the pollster’s previous survey in June 2026, with the new poll giving Democrat Talarico a 3-point lead. Libertarian candidate Ted Brown received support from 3 percent of respondents, while 1 percent responded, “someone else.” Crucially, 14 percent were still undecided about how they would vote in this election.
